summary.en: Explain architecture, relationships and data with spacious interactive pages: large zoomable diagrams, charts, tables and rotatable 3D scenes. Validates a structured description, saves an offline HTML page and opens the system's default browser.
summary.ru: Объяснять архитектуру, связи и данные на просторных интерактивных страницах: большие масштабируемые схемы, графики, таблицы и вращаемые 3D-сцены. Проверяет описание, сохраняет автономную HTML-страницу и открывает системный браузер по умолчанию.

required.name: artifacts
required.reason: to save the visualization as an offline HTML file you can keep

required.name: host.open
required.reason: to automatically open the generated page in your system's default browser

tools.name: validate
tools.summary: Check a page description without saving or opening anything. Returns valid and errors with field paths. Read references/format.md for section schemas.

page.description: Page with title, summary, language (en/ru), theme (dark/light), demo and sections. Sections: text, metrics, diagram, chart, table, scene3d. Read references/format.md first.

tools.name: show
tools.summary: Validate, generate and save an offline HTML page; automatically open it in the user's default browser. Invalid descriptions create no file and open nothing. Returns artifact, opened, and any open_error.

page.description: The same structured page as validate; follow references/format.md.

open_browser.description: False only when the person wants a file without opening it.
